endings.name: The One Who Left
endings.summary: Tam drove out alone at dusk on day 2. Home is ordinary; nobody remembers the four friends or the campground, and the notebook is the only proof. In the flat, the walkie in Tam's pack hisses on channel two, and a voice begins the list.
endings.cost: In the flat, the walkie in Tam's pack hisses on channel two, and a voice begins the list.

endings.name: Unlisted
endings.summary: Tam put the notebook on the fire at the second fire, and no guest slept inside. The crossing still comes, and the author's morning is unchanged. The walk out is by June's arm alone. At the booth nobody can say the line, so nobody is kept: the five walk past the window into a world that is not theirs, together, with no proof of anything.
endings.cost: Agnes's lines went on the fire with the rest. Nothing Tam saw is written anywhere, and nobody is kept to remember it.

endings.name: Nothing Missing
endings.summary: Tam took the world's word five or more times and said nothing was wrong. The morning is ordinary, and there are fewer of them in the van. June's forearm is clean.

endings.name: Held
endings.summary: The five sites held 12 or more weight at dark and stay in this world. Everything and everyone inside is safe, and no one outside remembers any of them. If Marisol was carried in, Ruth parks at the end of the gravel with a covered dish and cannot say why she cooked for two.
endings.cost: If Marisol was carried in, Ruth parks at the end of the gravel with a covered dish and cannot say why she cooked for two.

endings.name: Brought Along
endings.summary: A person slept inside, but the sites did not hold. They cross with the friends, and someone at home no longer knows to wait. Marisol says the line for the second time; Abel signs the register and finds his own name eleven years up the page.
endings.cost: Marisol says the line for the second time. Abel signs the register and finds his own name eleven years up the page.

endings.name: Slipped Through
endings.summary: The author's ending. Tam stayed and kept watching; on the final morning the sky is wrong and the phones show no signal, no time, no date. Added close: the walk out through the trees and a car arriving, and Tam's line through the window. After the line, Tam sets the notebook on the counter and rules the first column.
endings.cost: After the line, Tam sets the notebook on the counter and rules the first column. Every row kept, and no one to show them to.
